packageRules.description: Indirect Go deps are disabled by default -- only `tool` directive deps (golang.org/x/vuln) slip through, which is why google.golang.org/grpc sat at a vulnerable v1.82.1 with no bump PR until govulncheck flagged it in #28. Enabling them means transitive CVE fixes actually get raised; they still land grouped in the Go Minor/Major rules below.

terraform/version.tf pins the urllo provider to 0.0.1 to match ./build-local.sh's local filesystem-mirror build, not a registry release -- this repo IS that provider, so Renovate bumping it against the registry is both circular and wrong for local dev.
GitHub Actions, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
Go modules, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
mise-managed toolchain pins (mise.toml: go, terraform, golangci-lint, python, ruff, coverage, node), non-major.
mise-managed toolchain pins, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
npm devDependencies (semantic-release and its plugins), non-major.
npm devDependencies, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.

description: postUpdateOptions.gomodTidy: Renovate's `go get` only records the /go.mod hashes needed for module-graph resolution, not the h1: zip hashes needed to build a package -- without a tidy, go.sum ships incomplete and `go tool govulncheck` dies with 'missing go.sum entry'. Bit this repo twice (#21, #28).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes must not wait for the Monday window -- an empty schedule lets them raise a PR as soon as an advisory lands.
